Handoffs between agents occur when an agent cannot fulfill a user request with its available tools; it then transfers the conversation context to another agent that can take over.
Yes, an agent that has its own tools can still hand off to another agent.

[Handoffs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/introduction#handoffs)
